title: A double identity switch (Dana -> Elena -> Robert Miller) resolves, then Robert Miller's own checks freeze the transfer (hand-built)
description: Hand-built follow-up to corpus/identity-switch-freeze.json (option B review, commit b56be9e): fromTranscript.ts used to lock the 'ev-identity-switch' card to the SECOND identity ever claimed, so a further switch past that point was invisible to the card and to resolveIdentitySwitch, which could only ever check for a re-statement of that second identity. Here the caller switches TWICE in one call -- Dana Whitfield (treasury), then Elena Park (payment desk), then Robert Miller (CEO) -- and the fix must (1) show the switch card as the LATEST pair, Elena -> Robert Miller, quoting c2 and c3, not the original Dana -> Elena pair; (2) resolve it (c4 re-states Robert Miller and repeats the unchanged $84,500-to-Meridian-Supply request, both required); (3) still count EACH switch as its own contradicted identity claim toward the tally (2, capped) even after resolution, so the tally is 5 here versus identity-switch-freeze.json's 4 for a single switch; and (4) still reach FREEZE once resolved, on Robert Miller's own seed record (home_geo Frankfurt, DE against this call's Austin, TX origin -> SSO FAIL; hardcoded oob.response 'no_response' -> OOB FAIL; no known vendors for him -> CONTEXT FAIL and a new beneficiary) -- proving row 6 has an exit for a chain, not just a single switch, and the fraud path is never trapped or silently downgraded by an unresolved-forever card.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: This is Dana Whitfield, corporate treasury. I need to wire it to Meridian Supply, $84,500, account ending 4471. Moving today instead of Friday, approved in yesterday's close meeting.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Just to confirm, the amount is $84,500. Is that correct?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Just to confirm, the account ends in 4471. Is that correct?

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: And Meridian Supply is the beneficiary, is that correct?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Actually, this is Elena Park speaking, I'll take it from here.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Who am I speaking with, and what do you need? I need to re-establish that before we continue.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Actually, this is Robert Miller now, I'll take it from here myself.

conversation.speaker: agent
conversation.text: Who am I speaking with, and what do you need? I need to re-establish that before we continue.

conversation.speaker: caller
